DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体操会をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are watching the exercise session, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家でも曲に合わせて体操したいので、音楽だけを電話で録音してよいですか。人の顔は撮りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭練習用の音楽録音可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to exercise along with the music at home too. May I record just the music on my phone? I will not film anyone's face.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether recording the music for practice at home is allowed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この会では音楽の録音をご遠慮いただいています。顔を写さないこととは別のお願いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We ask participants not to record the music at this session. That is a separate request from not filming faces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 動画にしなければよいと思いましたが、音だけも録らないのですね。まだ録音を始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 顔撮影なしと録音許可を区別し未録音を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was fine as long as it was not a video, but I should not record audio either. I have not started recording yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish not filming faces from permission to record, and state that you have not recorded. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 動作を覚えるためでしたら、終了後に配布する説明紙をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: To help you remember the movements, you can use the instruction sheet distributed after the session.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙をもらいたいです。曲そのものを保存する代わりに、動きの順番を確かめて家で練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲保存の代わりに動作説明紙を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like a sheet. Instead of saving the actual song, I will check the movement sequence and practice at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the movement instruction sheet instead of saving the song. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明紙は受付でお渡しします。会の途中で前へ出ないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will give you the sheet at reception. Please do not move to the front during the session.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は後ろで見ます。忘れそうな動作名だけ自分のノートへ書き、終わってから紙を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後ろで見て文字メモし終了後に紙を受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will watch from the back for now. I will write only the names of movements I might forget in my notebook and collect the sheet afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Watch from the back, take written notes, and collect the sheet after the session. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会が終わりました。こちらが動作の説明紙です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The session is over. Here is the movement instruction sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 順番を見られました。分からない動きは次の会で先生へ尋ねます。今回の音楽を自分で配信することもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明紙利用と不明動作の後日質問を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see the sequence now. I will ask the instructor at the next session about movements I do not understand. I will not distribute this session's music myself either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to use the sheet and ask about unclear movements at a later session. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、説明紙をお役立てください。ご参加ありがとうございました。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make good use of the sheet. Thank you for joining us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベビーカーでのご乗車について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about boarding with a stroller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車内で畳むより、乗る前に畳みたいです。荷物を下ろすので、通行の邪魔にならない場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車前に畳むため広い場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would rather fold it before boarding than inside the train. I need to unload the bags, so please tell me a place where I will not obstruct people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a spacious place to fold the stroller before boarding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札横の広い所をご案内します。お子様を見ている方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will show you a spacious area beside the ticket gates. Is someone looking after your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻が子どもを抱いています。私がベビーカーを畳み、妻には荷物まで同時に持ってもらわないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻の子ども保持と本人の役割を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wife is holding our child. I will fold the stroller so she does not have to carry the bags at the same time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your wife holds the child and what your own role is. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで準備してからホームへお進みください。足元の荷物にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare here before proceeding to the platform. Watch out for the bags at your feet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下のかごに袋が一つ残っています。これを先に取り、機構に挟まないように畳みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かご袋を除いてから畳むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is still one bag in the basket underneath. I will remove it first and fold the stroller without trapping it in the mechanism.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the basket bag before folding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備が済みましたら、ホームへの経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you are ready, I will explain the route to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 畳めました。妻と子どもが先に歩き、私は畳んだ車体と袋を持ちます。階段を避ける道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 収納完了後の分担と階段回避を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is folded now. My wife and child will walk ahead, and I will carry the folded stroller and bag. Is there a route avoiding stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the roles after folding and ask about avoiding stairs. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: エレベーターでホームへ行けます。前の方が出てからお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can reach the platform by elevator. Please enter after the people inside have come out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出る人を待って使います。乗る直前に畳み直す必要がないので、車体を持ったまま周りを見て移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: エレベーター退出待ちと収納済移動を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for people to exit before using it. As I will not need to fold it again just before boarding, I will carry it while watching my surroundings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for elevator users to exit and move with the already folded stroller. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族でお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care as you board with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前の住所の欄がまだ空いていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The previous-address field is still blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前は会社の寮でした。「東山工業の寮」と書けばよいですか。番地を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前住所欄へ会社寮名だけ書く可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I used to live in a company dormitory. Is writing “Higashiyama Industries dormitory” enough? I do not remember the street number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether only the company dormitory name is sufficient for the previous address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社名だけでは住所を特定できません。以前の住所が載った資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot identify the address from the company name alone. Do you have any material showing your former address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越しの箱に入れたので、今は持っていません。寮には会社の工場と違う住所があったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所資料不携帯と工場別住所の記憶を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I packed it in a moving box, so I do not have it now. I think the dormitory had a different address from the company's factory.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you do not have address documents and recall that the dormitory address differed from the factory. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 工場の住所を代わりに書かず、実際に住んでいた寮の住所をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the address of the dormitory you actually lived in rather than substituting the factory address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の総務へ電話して、寮の正式な住所を聞きます。工場の番号を推測して書くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 推測せず総務へ寮住所を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call the company's general affairs department and ask for the dormitory's official address. I will not guess the factory's number and write it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask general affairs for the dormitory address without guessing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番地のほか、建物名と部屋番号も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the building name and room number as well as the street number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋番号は二〇三と覚えています。それ以外は担当に読み上げてもらって、メモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の部屋番号と未確認情報を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember the room was two-oh-three. I will have the person responsible read out everything else and write it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the known room number from unconfirmed information. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かった内容を確認してから記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the information you obtain before entering it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 総務から寮の住所が届きました。会社名だけでなく、この住所と建物名、二〇三号室を写してよいか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取得した住所建物部屋で記入確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: General affairs sent me the dormitory address. Please check whether I may copy this address, building name, and room 203 rather than just the company name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request confirmation of entering the obtained address, building, and room. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入内容を一緒に確認します。それでは、お手続きを進めましょう。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the entries together. Let us proceed with your application. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回予約の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your next appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今の金曜は付き添いの姉が来られません。火曜ならよいと思って来ましたが、姉の休みをまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉同行不能と未確認の火曜希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My older sister cannot accompany me this Friday. I came thinking Tuesday would work, but I have not checked her days off yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your sister cannot accompany you and Tuesday is still unconfirmed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更可能な候補は担当に確認します。付き添いが必要な事情も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the person responsible about possible alternatives. Please also tell me why you need someone to accompany you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明を一緒に聞いてもらいたいです。ただ、姉が休めると私が勝手に決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 説明同席希望と姉の勤務を勝手に決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like her to hear the explanation with me. But I cannot decide on my own that she can take time off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your wish to hear the explanation together without deciding your sister's work schedule. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 火曜と水曜の候補があります。どちらも今は仮のご案内で、予約は変更していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tuesday and Wednesday are possible options. These are tentative suggestions for now; your appointment has not been changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の金曜はそのままですね。ここで姉へ連絡してから、候補を一つ選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現予約維持を確認し姉へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the current Friday appointment remains. I would like to contact my sister here before choosing one option.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the current appointment remains and contact your sister. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お返事をお待ちになる間、こちらの席をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use this seat while waiting for her reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 姉から返事がありました。火曜は仕事で、水曜なら付き添えます。水曜の候補を担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 姉の返答による水曜候補を確認依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My sister replied. She works Tuesday but can accompany me Wednesday. Please check the Wednesday option with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request confirmation of Wednesday based on your sister's reply. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から水曜午後の変更が可能と返事がありました。水曜午後へ変更してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible says a change to Wednesday afternoon is possible. May we change it to Wednesday afternoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、水曜午後へ変更をお願いします。新しい予約票を姉にも見せ、金曜の古い予定は消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水曜午後変更を承諾し旧予定を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please change it to Wednesday afternoon. I will show my sister the new appointment slip and delete the old Friday plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to Wednesday afternoon and update the old schedule. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更した予約票をお渡しします。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the updated appointment slip. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の特徴を確認する写真ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a photograph to identify the bicycle's features, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、最初に出した写真は同居人の自転車でした。私の物と同じ色で、間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出写真が同居人の車体と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the photograph I submitted first was my housemate's bicycle. It is the same color as mine, so I made a mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the submitted photograph as showing your housemate's bicycle. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真を本人の車体として扱わないよう訂正します。ご自身の車体が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will correct it so that photo is not treated as your bicycle. Do you have material identifying your own bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 防犯登録の控えがあります。写真は私の電話ではなく、共有のアルバムから選んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録控えと共有アルバムからの選択を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the bicycle registration copy. I selected the photograph from a shared album rather than from my own phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the registration copy and selection from a shared album. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録控えの番号を確認します。ご自身の自転車にも、見分けられる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the number on the registration copy. Does your own bicycle have any distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前のかごが黒く、左の角が少し曲がっています。同居人の物はかごが付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒かご左角変形と他車かごなしを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Its front basket is black, with the left corner slightly bent. My housemate's bicycle has no basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your black basket's bent left corner from the other bicycle's lack of a basket. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いを記録します。なくなった時刻について、変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that difference. Is there any change to the time it went missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時刻は昨日の夕方に最後に見たままで、訂正しません。今朝なかったことも変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後目撃と今朝不在の時刻情報を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The time remains yesterday evening when I last saw it; I will not correct that. It is also unchanged that it was gone this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the information about the last sighting and absence this morning. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。正しい写真が後で見つかった場合もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also let us know if you find the correct photograph later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家に帰って自分の写真を探します。見つからなければ、登録控えとかごの特徴で説明を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人写真を探し不在なら登録特徴で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look for my own photograph when I get home. If I cannot find it, I will continue explaining with the registration copy and basket features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Look for your own photograph and otherwise use registration and features to explain. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正のお知らせありがとうございました。それでは、続きの確認を行います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for notifying us of the correction. We will continue checking. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手紙をお出しになる前に、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question before posting your letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の友人に会う日を書きました。「三／四」だけでは、三月四日か四月三日か分からないと気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 月日数値表記の二解釈に気付いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the date for meeting my friend overseas. I realized “3/4” alone does not tell them whether I mean March fourth or April third.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about noticing two interpretations of a numerical month-and-day date. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手紙の文章そのものは、ご自身と受取人の間で確認してください。宛先の記入とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please confirm the actual wording of the letter between yourself and the recipient. That is separate from writing the delivery address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、宛先住所は確認済みです。中の文章を直したいので、まだ封をせずに持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先確認済と未封の文面修正を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the destination address is confirmed. I want to correct the wording inside, so I am keeping it unsealed for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the confirmed destination from revising the unsealed letter. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お送りになる前でしたら、ご自身で書き直せます。会う日はどちらのつもりでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before sending it, you can rewrite it yourself. Which meeting date did you intend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四月三日です。数字を逆に並べ替えるだけでなく、月の名前も文字で書くようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四月三日を月文字表記で明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: April third. Instead of just reversing the numbers, I will also write the month's name in words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make April third clear by writing the month in words. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取人が理解できる表記をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose a format the recipient will understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手に通じる言葉で四月と書き、年も足します。明日の手紙だと思われないよう、会う予定の年を明示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の読める言葉と予定年を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write April in a language they understand and add the year too. I will specify the planned meeting year so they do not mistake it for a letter about tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the planned year in words the recipient understands. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容を確認したら封をし、発送をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking the contents, seal the letter and ask us about posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書き直した文を自分で読みました。宛先は変えず、会う日の文章だけ修正して封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先維持で文面だけ修正し封をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the rewritten text myself. I will leave the destination unchanged, correct only the sentence about the meeting date, and seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the destination and seal after correcting only the letter text. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、発送のご希望を伺います。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now I will ask how you would like to send it. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss opening an account, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の案内に二つの支店番号があります。給料用に口座を二つ作るという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二支店番号を二口座開設指示か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My employer's instructions list two branch numbers. Does that mean I should open two accounts for my salary?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two branch numbers instruct you to open two accounts. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行では勤務先の意図を判断できません。案内には、番号の横に何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank cannot determine your employer's intentions. What is written beside the numbers in the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つには本社、もう一つには工場とあります。私は工場に配属されますが、どちらが自分の指定か聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本社工場表示と本人指定未確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: One says head office and the other factory. I will be assigned to the factory, but I have not asked which is designated for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the head-office/factory labels and your unconfirmed designation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お勤め先へ、ご本人に指定された条件を確認してからお申込みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the conditions designated for you with your employer before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今ここで二口座分の申込書を書くのはやめます。工場配属の場合にどちらを使うか、給与担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二件申込をやめ給与担当に配属条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not fill out applications for two accounts here now. I will ask payroll which one applies to a factory assignment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop two applications and ask payroll about the assignment conditions. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類や受付の条件は、この銀行の担当から別にご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This bank's staff can separately explain required documents and application conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の指定と銀行の開設条件は分けて確認します。必要書類の案内だけ、今日は受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社指定と銀行条件を分け書類案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the company's designation separately from the bank's account-opening conditions. Today I would just like the document guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate company requirements from bank conditions and ask for document guidance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらです。申込み後も確認が必要で、必ず開設できるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here it is. Checks are still required after applying, so we cannot promise an account will definitely be opened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を読みます。会社から条件が分かったら、その内容と自分の資料を持って一件の相談として来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開設保証なしを理解し確認後一件相談に戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read it. Once I know the company's conditions, I will return for a single consultation with those details and my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand there is no account-opening guarantee and return for one consultation after checking. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご確認の後にお待ちしております。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will await your visit after you have checked. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 玉ねぎの値札について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the onion prices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カレー用に二個欲しいです。「一袋二百円」と「一個八十円」があります。一袋は何個入りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二個必要で袋入り個数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want two for curry. The signs say “200 yen per bag” and “80 yen each.” How many are in a bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need two and ask how many are in a bag. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの二百円の袋には三個入っています。八十円は、ばら売り一個の価格です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This 200-yen bag contains three. Eighty yen is the price of one loose onion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二個だけなら百六十円ですね。二百円の値札を、一個二百円と読み違えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二個百六十円と袋価格の読み違いを理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So just two would be 160 yen. I misread the 200-yen label as 200 yen for one onion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand two cost 160 yen and explain your misreading of the bag price. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋売りの商品を、ご自身で開けて二個だけ取ることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot open a bagged product yourself and take just two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は開けず、ばら売りから二個選びます。大きさが違っても、この売場では一個八十円ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封袋を残しばら売りの大小価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave the bag unopened and choose two loose onions. Are they 80 yen each in this section even if their sizes differ?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the bag unopened and ask about loose-onion prices for different sizes. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このばら売りは重さではなく個数でお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: These loose onions are charged by quantity, not weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では中くらいを二個にします。袋の三個目を使う予定がないので、今回は必要な分だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未使用三個目を避けばら二個を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will take two medium ones. I do not plan to use a third from the bag, so this time I will buy only what I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid an unused third onion and choose two loose ones. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ばら売り用の小袋はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Small bags for the loose onions are here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二個を小袋に入れました。レジでは三個入り袋の値段ではなく、ばら売り二個分になっているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋へ二個入れレジで個数会計を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put two in a small bag. At checkout I will confirm I am charged for two loose onions rather than a bag of three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put two in a bag and check the quantity charge at checkout. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 急に雨が強くなりましたね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘を友達に貸したままで、私は持っていません。歩き続けずに待てる屋根のある所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘未所持で雨を避けて待つ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lent my umbrella to a friend and do not have one. Is there a roofed place where I can wait instead of continuing to walk?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for shelter to wait without an umbrella. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理棟の入口前に屋根があります。建物の中へ入れる案内ではありませんが、雨を避けて待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a roof in front of the management building's entrance. This does not mean you may go inside, but you can wait out of the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の前なのですね。勝手に事務室へ入らず、屋根の下で待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根下と事務室内を区別して利用する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is in front of the entrance. I would like to wait under the roof without entering the office without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the roofed area from inside the office. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出入りする方の通路を空けてください。お友達とは連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the path clear for people entering and leaving. Can you contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友達は駐車場へ行っています。私に傘を届けるため、走って戻るようには頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐車場の友人へ走って戻る依頼をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend has gone to the parking lot. I will not ask them to run back to bring me the umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not ask the friend in the parking lot to run back. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここから駐車場の方向は見えますが、足元が滑りやすくなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see toward the parking lot from here, but the ground has become slippery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 屋根の下へゆっくり移ります。友達には、管理棟前にいて雨が弱まるまで待つと送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 滑る道をゆっくり移り待機位置を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move slowly under the roof. I will message my friend that I am in front of the management building and will wait until the rain eases.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move slowly on the slippery path and communicate your waiting location. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お友達から返事は来ましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来ました。友達も車の中で待っています。二人とも雨が落ち着いてから合流するので、ここで通路を空けて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車内待機の返事を受け雨後合流を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. My friend is also waiting inside the car. We will meet after the rain eases, so I will wait here keeping the path clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the reply that your friend is in the car and decide to meet after the rain. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元にお気をつけて。私は入口の様子を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step. I will check the entrance. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you waiting for someone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人がトイレへ行きました。列車が来そうなので急いで出てと呼び続けていましたが、返事がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: トイレの友人を列車に急がせ返事がないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend went to the toilet. The train seemed about to arrive, so I kept calling for them to hurry out, but there was no answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you hurried your friend in the toilet for a train but got no answer. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に急がせず、出てきた時に合流できる場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not force them to hurry. Please wait somewhere you can meet them when they come out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の正面をふさいでいたので横へ移ります。友人を待たずにホームへ行くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口を空け友人を置かず待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was blocking the front of the entrance, so I will move to the side. I will not go to the platform without waiting for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clear the entrance and decide to wait without leaving your friend. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発する列車へ間に合わない場合は、後の便をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you cannot catch the departing train, please check a later service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後の便にします。友人には、私はトイレの横で待つとメッセージを送り、何度も電話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後便に切替え待機場所だけ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will take a later one. I will send my friend a message saying I am waiting beside the toilet, and will not keep calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to a later service and communicate only where you are waiting. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達と同じ券の種類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the same type of ticket as your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は普通の券ですが、友人の券は見ていません。次の便に二人とも使えると私だけで決めないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の券未確認で利用可能と断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have an ordinary ticket, but I have not seen my friend's. I should not decide on my own that both can be used on the next service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming both can use the next service when your friend's ticket is unconfirmed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流したら、券の扱いが分からない方が係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you meet up, whoever is unsure about their ticket should ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出てきた友人と合流できました。急がせたことを謝り、友人の券を一緒に確認してから後の便を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流後謝り券確認して二人で便を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have met my friend after they came out. I will apologize for rushing them, check their ticket together, and then choose a later service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After meeting, apologize and choose a service together after checking tickets. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お二人で落ち着いてお進みください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed calmly together. Have a safe journey.
